pageQuotes.excerpt: Industrifonden – Sweden’s Venture Capital Fund Home Team Portfolio About us News & Insights Meet Us Talent Contact WE'RE SWEDEN'S Venture Capital Fund We back unique, scalable innovations with the patient capital and staying power to see them through — from first check to global scale. read more TICKET SIZE - PORTFOLIO COMPANIES ASSETS UNDER MANAGEMENT IPOS NORDIC INNOVATIONS Bringing breakthroughs to the world Industrifonden is an evergreen venture capital fund backing innovative companies with the potential to fundamentally reshape industries and create long-term value for society. We invest with patience and conviction, supporting companies through complexity and critical inflection points, enabling them to scale globally. As an evergreen, fund terms do not dictate our timeline – we're in it for the long run. Our focus is Sweden, but our reach extends across the New Nordics where we participate in strong syndicates alongside local co-investors, backing exceptional companies wherever they're building in the region. FAQ | Industrifonden Home Team Portfolio About us News & Insights Meet Us Talent Contact FAQ Our Investment 01 When is the right time to approach Industrifonden about investing? We are interested to invest when your startup has demonstrated initial evidence and is ready to accelerate, usually in Seed or A-round funding. Ideally, contact us at least six months before you plan to close the funding. It is common that we received previous updates from the company and have been able to follow progress for a certain time before the funding process started. 02 What criteria do you use for investments? We focus on unique and scalable innovations. We seek passionate founders and teams with the capability to turn visionary ideas into reality, and concepts that have the potential to revolutionize or create new industries. We believe that mixed teams with complementing capabilities are best positioned to succeed. 03 How should I approach Industrifonden for an investment? Please send your pitch deck to a relevant member of our investment team. Given the high volume of inquiries we receive, only select proposals that fit our focus areas will lead to an initial call or meeting. 04 What is your investment process and how long does it take? Submitted pitch decks areevaluated. Due to the high number of inquiries, we only schedule meetings with those that best align with our investment criteria.
We invest in early-stage companies, from seed to A-round funding, sometimes earlier.
For exceptional technologies, we also consider smaller tickets for pre-seed funding of important milestones.
We organize our team into four strategies with expertise in Deep Tech & Plantery Health, Life Science, Software and Growth.
Our focus is on Swedish innovations, in Life Science and Deep Tech we also consider investments across the new Nordics.

Industrifonden Home Team Portfolio About us News & Insights Meet Us Talent Contact News OlsAro closes €5m seed investment to scale climate-resilient cereal genetics Published 14.10.26 OlsAro, the Swedish AgTech company developing climate-resilient cereal genetics, has raised €5 million in seed funding to develop its SeedAX platform and bring its first salinity-resilient wheat product to market. The round was led by Industrifonden, with Nordic Foodtech VC joining as co-lead. Existing investors Future Food Fund, PINC (Paulig’s venture arm), AgFunder and GU Ventures also participated. The financing follows OlsAro’s €2.5 million pre-seed round in April 2024, bringing the total raised by the Swedish company to date to approximately €7.5 million. Salinity already affects around a tenth of the world’s cropland. Heat and drought are also putting pressure on cereal production, increasing the need for varieties that can maintain yields under these conditions. OlsAro develops cereal traits and varieties, with an initial focus on wheat. Its SeedAX platform combines proprietary genetics and data, AI-driven trait discovery and genetic technologies to identify and validate climate-resilience traits, then integrate them into elite germplasm for commercial seed programmes. OlsAro’s salinity-resilient wheat has shown an up to 41% yield increase over a moderately salt-tolerant variety under
The recent funding will support international field trials and commercial work with seed-company partners as OlsAro prepares to bring its first product to market.
It will also fund further R&D efforts, AI-driven trait discovery and expand the company’s IP portfolio.
Elén Faxö, CEO, OlsAro said: " We have spent years proving that we can identify and develop genetics that perform under some of the conditions putting the greatest pressure on agriculture.
This round is about turning that capability into a platform seed companies can use repeatedly.
By expanding SeedAX across more traits and markets, we can help our partners bring climate-resilient cereals to farmers faster and at much greater scale.

Our story – Industrifonden Home Team Portfolio About us News & Insights Meet Us Talent Contact ABOUT US We’re in it for the long run, experience has taught us that developing fundamental innovations takes time. EN SV Ticket SIZE - PORTFOLIO COMPANIES FUNDS UNDER MANAGEMENT IPOS Industrifonden was founded by the Swedish government in 1979 as an independent foundation to provide Swedish industry with an innovation growth engine. For more than four decades, we've backed high-tech ventures from first check to global scale – accumulating pattern recognition and knowledge across cycles Our focus is Sweden, but our reach extends across the New Nordics where we participate in strong syndicates alongside local co-investors, backing exceptional companies wherever they're building in the region. Today, we are an independent venture capital fund continuing our legacy by partnering with innovators and entrepreneurs to bring Nordic breakthrough innovations to the world. From QlikTech, Arcam and Oatly to CellaVision, Inriver, and Calliditas, we've backed companies that reshaped their industries – and we exit when the company is ready, not when a fund term ends. We invest in early-stage companies. Our first ticket is often €1–5million, with capacity to invest considerably more over a company's lifecycle. We invest across four areas – life science, deep tech, software, and growth – each led by
We invest across four areas – life science, deep tech, software, and growth – each led by specialists with deep domain expertise and the networks that come with it.
WHEn WE INVEST SEED TO A-ROUND FUNDING We typically invest in early-stage companies in seed or A-rounds, and sometimes earlier.
For exceptional opportunities we can invest earlier with smaller pre-seed tickets.
In therapeutics, we look for robust science and a genuinely differentiated approach to a significant unmet need.
We look for vertical AI and enterprise software teams with genuine conviction about the problem they're solving, and early proof that the market agrees.

DEEP TECH & PLANETARY HEALTH We have backed technical founders for decades, and know that deep tech runs on a different clock: long development cycles, capital-intensive scale-up, and value that arrives in steps rather than smoothly.
We invest across energy systems, advanced materials, synthetic biology, novel computing, and the technologies that protect and restore the planet.
We usually come in once the core science is proven and the remaining risk sits in engineering, scale-up, and commercial execution rather than fundamental discovery.
GROWTH We have spent decades helping Nordic companies grow into international ones, and we know that scaling is a different discipline from building.
We invest where capital can accelerate sales, new market entry, and operational scaling, and where unit economics are strongenough to make that growth durable.
